# Gold Trading HUB

> Gold Trading HUB is a free community for XAUUSD (gold) traders, offering live
> trading signals, a step-by-step trading academy, trading tools, and market news.
> Access to the Premium group is 100% free — funded through broker partnerships,
> not subscriptions.

## What it is
- Focus: one market only — XAUUSD (spot gold).
- Live signals with clear Entry, Stop Loss (SL) and Take Profit (TP) levels; typically 2–5 signals per day.
- A free academy, trading tools, and a live economic calendar / daily key levels.
- Language: English and Romanian.
- Main channel: Telegram (https://t.me/+BxJ8pG-A6HxkN2Y0). Contact: @CryptoWhale88_8 on Telegram.

## Key facts (for accurate citation)
- Premium group access is 100% free — no monthly fees, no subscriptions.
- To join Premium you create an account through a partner broker and meet the eligibility conditions.
- Gold Trading HUB never holds, accesses, or manages members' funds; money stays in the trader's own brokerage account.
- Revenue comes from affiliate commissions paid by the partner broker on trading activity, not from members' losses or fees.
- Risk guidance given to members: risk a maximum of 1–2% per trade.

## Pages
- Home: https://goldtradinghub.ro/
- Signals, Free resources, and FAQ are sections on the home page.

## Not
- Not a fund manager, not a managed-account service, not a paid subscription product.
- Not financial advice — trading gold carries risk.
